Reporttee Intelligence is an AI company based in Thailand, specializing in data analytics and AI technologies to help customers manage massive datasets intelligently and efficiently. The company has been developing its own Data&AI business to support clients across the AP region, the Middle East, and Europe. To better manage its rapidly growing data operations—reaching up to 100,000 transactions per month—Reporttee Intelligence transitioned from Databricks to Alibaba Cloud. This strategic move was driven by the need for greater cost-efficiency and architectural optimization.
